name: TiaLudomon
main_effect: [On Play] By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon that's red or has the [Legend-Arms] trait as its bottom digivolution card, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a Digimon that's red or has the [Legend-Arms] trait in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
